gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-tamil: Distinctive, with Unica One drawing every stroke at a single thickness. Over a full page, Anek Tamil moves along on big round bowls and curves that look half unwrapped, which feels modern and unhurried.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-telugu: Commanding Unica One holds a pen-like line of constant weight throughout. Anek Telugu brings wide, tall bowls and rounds left open like an unlatched hook, and that generosity is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anuphan: Unica One's huge lowercase eyes let daylight into every curve. That wiry line grabs attention up top, while Anuphan, a plain sans with round bowls, does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-arimo: Big open eyes, one steady line, all Unica One. Arimo, plain sans with a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, steps back politely, and that restraint is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-armata: Armata reads wide and spacious, its lowercase filling most of the line height. Unica One, bent like a single length of wire, earns its keep set big over a short phrase, where its commanding presence has room.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-athiti: Athiti sets its mean line high and leaves each s see-through. Athiti, the sans-serif, can nudge up a size beside Unica One, whose single-width lines already command plenty of attention.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads plainly, with wide-set terminals on its s. Beside the wire-fine strokes of Unica One, paragraphs of it feel approachable, with capitals that look clipped next to the lowercase.
Pressure-free lines, big open eyes: that's Unica One. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like stencil bridges stretched open, so whole paragraphs breathe easily into the white space.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads contemporary and approachable, its lowercase eyes as big as washers and its rounds left unlatched. Unica One's thin bent rod letters supply the muscle up top.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-biryani: Approachable Biryani gives every e a large, clear eye. Unica One does its best work large and commanding, while Biryani, the sans with no stroke modulation at all, handles the quiet job of being read.
